newsitem.title: CHINA: China $108 mln petrochem joint venture starts up.
newsitem.headline: China $108 mln petrochem joint venture starts up.

text.p: A 900 million yuan ($108 million) joint venture petrochemical company has started operation in northwestern China's Gansu province, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The venture in the provincial capital Lanzhou was set up between the Lanzhou Oil Refinery and Chemical Plant and the Hong Kong China Travel Service Group, Xinhua said.
Lanzhou Oil Refinery has a 51 percent stake in the project while Hong Kong Travel holds 49 percent. The project is the largest joint venture in the province, it said.
The new company has three oil processing facilities and a medium-pressure boiler capable of producing 110 tonnes of gas an hour, it said, but gave no details
